intro:
A **45-minute** timed test on the whole of Force and Translational Dynamics. It is **generated fresh every time you open it** — a new set of questions, drawn from every lesson in the unit, in a new order, with the answer choices shuffled. The mix follows the Physics Academy test blueprint (`docs/test-generation.md`): the median question sits at the AP-standard level and about a third are at or above the AP-5 line, so clearing this comfortably means you are on track for **90%+** on the real exam.

Multiple choice is scored automatically. Free response is scored by you, against the model answer and rubric. A calculator **is** permitted (matching the AP Physics 1 exam).
